overview: The Valley is a patchwork of municipalities that clients treat as one market. Practices that name the cities they serve and explain online availability reach far more of it than a single-city page.
We work with Phoenix practices remotely, from our base in the Niagara region of Ontario.

city_blurbs.phoenix: Municipal fragmentation across Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa and Chandler, with retirees and families searching differently.
